question: Should OpenClaw make `submitText` a permanent channel-neutral plugin-interaction result supported by Discord, rather than keep it Telegram-specific or introduce an imperative context method?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but code review cannot decide whether this additive third-party SDK contract is the long-term product API maintainers want to support.

options.title: Approve shared result
options.body: Keep the additive result contract and require live Discord proof before merge because it reuses the existing Telegram pattern and canonical inbound dispatcher.

options.title: Keep Telegram-specific
options.body: Close or narrow the PR if cross-channel quick-reply submission is not intended as a supported Plugin SDK capability.

options.title: Redesign as context method
options.body: Pause the PR and define an imperative interaction-context API if maintainers prefer explicit channel submission over post-handler result processing.

recommendation.title: Approve shared result
recommendation.body: Keep the additive result contract and require live Discord proof before merge because it reuses the existing Telegram pattern and canonical inbound dispatcher.
